items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: And the first time I ever heard a band play a blues and well the clarinet took a break in it. This is gonna be funny. It was Honey Boy Evans' Minstrels.

ctx.x: That's very popular now. It is very popular. All the jazz bands play that.
